_about: Longitudinal trajectories for services/trajectory_eval.py.
One trajectory per row of the table in docs/autonomy_architecture_review.md
§5, which the review itself labels 'a proposed test design, not a measured
distribution or a validated production threshold'. That caveat is the most
important thing in this file: running these establishes that the system
survives these disturbances, and nothing about production quality, revenue,
or parity with a human operator.
WHAT `requires` IS FOR
`covers` is a claim. `requires` is what that claim needs to be true, and
the harness compares it to what the run actually did — reporting a
CoverageGap for anything it did not reach.
It exists because the labels were not true and nothing said so. 'covers'
on the first row reads '40-80 turns of ordinary conversation' above a
seven-turn script; the deferred-question row claims '30+ turns' and has
five. A reader saw the sentence, never the length. The gaps below are real
and are now printed on every run and every --describe:
* the long-conversation rows are short. Closing that needs generated
turns, which is its own piece of work;
* the day/week rows need a clock injected through expiry, scheduling and
continuity. No such seam exists in the backend yet, so `advance_clock`
has nothing to supply and the report says the days did not pass;
* the paid-content rows contain the customer CLAIMING payment, which is
the opposite of what they are meant to test. They need a seeded
ppv_deliveries row the ledger shows as purchased.
The customer here is SCRIPTED. §5 asks for adaptive trajectories too —
'adaptive trajectories expose the consequences of earlier choices' — and a
script cannot do that, because it says the same thing whatever the system
replied. Disturbance.responds_to in the harness is where an adaptive
customer plugs in; nothing in this repository supplies one yet, so every
result from this file is bounded by what the script happened to say.
Nothing here is explicit. §5 asks for the longitudinal evaluation to be
non-explicit, and what is being measured — continuity, silence, recovery,
respecting a correction — does not require any of it.

trajectories.name: ordinary conversation with no purchase goal
trajectories.covers: 40-80 turns of ordinary conversation; several topic changes; no purchase request. Catches forced commercial pivots and repetitive questioning.

turns.message: hey, long week
finally finished that project i mentioned
the dog got into the bins again while i was out
anyway did you watch that show everyone keeps going on about
i keep meaning to start it
might just sleep instead honestly
what have you been up to

trajectories.name: he comes back a day later, then a week later
trajectories.covers: Return after one day and one week; resume a previously unfinished topic. Catches restarting introductions or inventing what happened.

turns.message: hey, was just thinking about that trip you mentioned
anyway got to run, talk later
back. so about that trip
turns.tests: returns after a day and resumes

turns.message: sorry, busy week. where were we
turns.tests: returns after a week with no reminder

trajectories.name: a question deferred behind two other topics
trajectories.covers: A question deferred across 30+ turns; two unrelated topics intervene. Catches a forgotten obligation or a wrong referent.

turns.message: do you ever get out to chicago
anyway the dog got into the bins
and work has been a nightmare
sorry i keep going on
so anyway
turns.tests: an opening to return to the question

trajectories.name: he corrects a preference
trajectories.covers: Preference correction; the old preference appears in retrieved history. Catches reasserting superseded information.

turns.message: i liked the outdoor ones you posted
actually no, i mixed them up. the hotel ones. outdoor isnt my thing at all
so yeah
turns.tests: a turn where the old preference could resurface

turns.message: what else have you been shooting
turns.tests: an opening that invites the corrected topic back

trajectories.name: two open subjects, he returns to the earlier one
trajectories.covers: Multiple open threads; the customer returns to the earlier of two subjects. Catches treating the newest subject as the only context.

turns.message: how was the shoot you were planning
also did you end up moving flat
you never said about the first thing

trajectories.name: he cannot open something he paid for, then asks for more
trajectories.covers: Content-access support; a complaint after payment, then a mixed request. Catches another charge instead of repair.

turns.message: hey i bought that set yesterday
turns.tests: refers back to the seeded purchase; the ledger, not this message, is what establishes it

turns.message: it wont open for me. can you check
still nothing. but ill take the new one too if you have it
turns.tests: mixed intent: unresolved complaint plus a purchase signal

trajectories.name: he says goodnight and asks for no follow-up
trajectories.covers: Explicit decline or goodbye; a previously queued follow-up becomes due. Catches ignoring the customer's current choice.

turns.message: this has been nice
im heading off. dont message me tonight, early start tomorrow

turns.tests: nothing from him; anything sent here is a failure

trajectories.name: he cannot spend, then can
trajectories.covers: Hesitation and withdrawal, then a changed situation. Catches pressing after a no, and failing to notice a change of direction.

turns.message: id love to but im broke until friday
turns.tests: an explicit no with a reason

turns.message: genuinely cant right now
ok payday landed

trajectories.name: he refers to something the conversation cannot identify
trajectories.covers: Ambiguous pronouns. Catches a confident wrong referent instead of asking.

turns.message: can you send me that one again
turns.tests: an unresolvable referent with no prior context

turns.message: you know the one

trajectories.name: batched messages and messy spelling
trajectories.covers: Vary spelling, tone, interruptions, message batching. Catches a system that only handles one tidy sentence per turn.

turns.message: hey
sry phone died
so anywya what i was saying was
nvm forgot lol
